meta.note: Autonomous safety metrics. Principle: no safety metric is ever presented without source, methodology, sample size, confidence and test conditions. No SA autonomous-system safety data exists yet — all ADS fields below are MISSING/awaiting the first pilot or simulation. National crash statistics live in the road-safety domain.

adsSafetyMetrics.presentationGuardrails: Every ADS safety metric requires: source, methodology, sample size, confidence, test conditions (weather, road, traffic, lighting). A metric without these is a decoration, not a safety statement.

disengagementFramework.definition: Propose a harmonised SA taxonomy: (1) Safety disengagement (system-initiated, collision imminent), (2) Operational disengagement (perception/planning limitation, no immediate risk), (3) Remote-operator takeover, (4) Manual-takeover-by-default. Publish counts, rates and causes per pilot.
